# Candidate Profile — Priya Nair

Location: Seattle, WA, USA
Email: priya.nair.dev@gmail.com
Phone: +1 206 555 0142

## Summary

Backend engineer with 6 years of experience building distributed systems and
data platforms. Currently leading the platform reliability workstream at
Globex Systems.

## Employment history

Senior Software Engineer — Globex Systems (2021-08 – present)
Leads a 4-person platform team. Designed the service mesh migration that cut
P99 latency by 40%. Owns the Kubernetes deployment pipeline for 30+
microservices. Mentors two junior engineers.

Software Engineer — Acme Cloud (2019-01 – 2021-06)
Built ingestion services in Python handling 2TB/day. Introduced SQL-based
data quality checks that caught a billing bug before it shipped. Worked
closely with the SRE team on on-call rotations.

Junior Developer — StartCo (2017-07 – 2018-12)
First engineering role out of university. Built internal tooling in Python
and contributed to the company's first system design doc for a multi-tenant
architecture.

## Education

B.Tech, Computer Science — RV College of Engineering (2013–2017)

## Skills

Python, Kubernetes, System Design, SQL, Distributed Systems, Service Mesh
(Istio), Docker, CI/CD (Jenkins), Mentoring

## Certifications

Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), 2022

# Job Description — Senior Backend Engineer, Platform Team

Location: Seattle, WA (hybrid — interview is in-person where possible)
Experience level: 5+ years

## Must-have skills

- Python
- Kubernetes
- System Design
- SQL

## Nice-to-have skills

- Service Mesh (Istio)
- Mentoring
- CI/CD (Jenkins)

## Role summary

We're hiring a senior backend engineer to own reliability and scale for our
platform team — the same team that runs our core data ingestion and service
mesh. The role owns production deployment pipelines and partners closely
with SRE on on-call.

## What we're screening for

- Demonstrated ownership of a production Kubernetes deployment pipeline
- Comfort with distributed systems failure modes, not just happy-path design
- SQL fluency for data-quality and operational debugging, not just app code
- Bonus: experience mentoring junior engineers, since this role will grow
  into a team-lead track within a year
